source(output(
		NPI as string,
		Peer_Group as string,
		Facility_Type as string,
		Source_System as string,
		City as string,
		Medicare_Provider_ID as string,
		Facility_ID as string,
		Hospital_System as string,
		Operating_Certificate_Number as string,
		Tax_Identification_Number as string,
		Facility_County as string,
		State as string,
		Zip_Code as string,
		Facility_Name as string,
		Street_Address_2 as string,
		Street_Address_1 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT   LTRIM(RTRIM(Facility_ID)) AS Facility_ID , LTRIM(RTRIM(NPI)) AS NPI , LTRIM(RTRIM(Medicare_Provider_ID)) AS Medicare_Provider_ID , LTRIM(RTRIM(Facility_Name)) AS Facility_Name , LTRIM(RTRIM(Street_Address_1)) AS Street_Address_1 , LTRIM(RTRIM(Street_Address_2)) AS Street_Address_2 , LTRIM(RTRIM(City)) AS City , LTRIM(RTRIM(State)) AS State , LTRIM(RTRIM(Zip_Code)) AS Zip_Code , LTRIM(RTRIM(Facility_County)) AS Facility_County , LTRIM(RTRIM(Hospital_System)) AS Hospital_System , LTRIM(RTRIM(Peer_Group)) AS Peer_Group , LTRIM(RTRIM(Facility_Type)) AS Facility_Type , LTRIM(RTRIM(Operating_Certificate_Number)) AS Operating_Certificate_Number , LTRIM(RTRIM(Tax_Identification_Number)) AS Tax_Identification_Number , LTRIM(RTRIM(Source_System)) AS Source_System FROM EXTRACT.FL_3M_facility',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		NPI as string,
		Peer_Group as string,
		Facility_Type as string,
		Source_System as string,
		City as string,
		Medicare_Provider_ID as string,
		Facility_ID as string,
		Hospital_System as string,
		Operating_Certificate_Number as string,
		Tax_Identification_Number as string,
		Facility_County as string,
		State as string,
		Zip_Code as string,
		Facility_Name as string,
		Street_Address_2 as string,
		Street_Address_1 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		NPI,
		Peer_Group,
		Facility_Type,
		Source_System,
		City,
		Medicare_Provider_ID,
		Facility_ID,
		Hospital_System,
		Operating_Certificate_Number,
		Tax_Identification_Number,
		Facility_County,
		State,
		Zip_Code,
		Facility_Name,
		Street_Address_2,
		Street_Address_1)) ~> FlatFileDestination
